suppress.notes: Kotlin stdlib does not contain KAPT. The upstream fix is restricted to plugins/kapt/kapt-base incremental cache deserialization, and Numeris Android uses KSP without applying KAPT. https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/commit/bf51df6

These advisories affect the Tasks.org application and its VoiceCommandActivity and ShareLinkActivity components. This artifact is JetBrains' integration between Kotlin coroutines and Google Play Services Tasks; it is not the org.tasks application. https://github.com/tasks/tasks/security/advisories/GHSA-8x58-cg74-8jg8

These advisories affect GitHub Enterprise Server. This artifact is the Android runtime library for Skydoves Compose Stability Analyzer; OWASP incorrectly maps its com.github group and repository URL to the GitHub server product. https://github.com/skydoves/compose-stability-analyzer https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-server@2.21/admin/release-notes

CVE-2025-29903 affects the OpenJDK-based JetBrains Runtime on macOS before 21.0.6b872.80. This artifact is an Android Compose Multiplatform UI runtime library, not that JVM distribution; OWASP incorrectly maps its runtime name to the JetBrains Runtime CPE. https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5/blob/main/cves/2025/29xxx/CVE-2025-29903.json https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsRuntime
